needs_you.title: Check the test account's Roblox security settings
needs_you.detail: A 2-Step Verification email was sent after a glitch (Apex was pressing keys when the game wasn't on screen). That is fixed. Ignore or delete that code, and make sure the security settings look unchanged.

needs_you.title: Turn off HP warranty popups on the test laptop
needs_you.detail: The HP Product Status box can cover the game and throw off a test. Turn off HP Support Assistant notifications.

needs_you.title: Keep the test laptop on the charger
needs_you.detail: It's back online. Set Windows Power options so it never sleeps or shows battery popups while plugged in.

needs_you.title: Add an auto-rejoin toggle to the Settings tab
needs_you.detail: The new auto-rejoin setting (on by default) only lives in the settings file right now. Your UI, so your call when.
